LESSON: COOKING: PREPARING A BALANCED MEAL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.6: Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can we prepare a balanced meal for healthy living?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: The learners care for property as they use resources to cook a balanced meal with protein, carbohydrate and vegetables.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Disaster Risk Reduction: The learner observes safety to prevent fire disaster in the kitchen while using fire to prepare meals.

Link to other subjects:

• Learners relate consumption of balanced meals to prevention of lifestyle diseases learnt in Integrated Science.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Digital devices

• Charts

• Sign Language Dictionary

• Locally available source of protein, carbohydrates and vitamins,

• Kitchen equipment such as cutlery, saucepans, ladle

• Fuel and respective cooking equipment
